sn45.174:1.3: abhijjhā kāyagantho vyāpādā kāyagantho sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho idaṃsaccābhiniveso kāyagantho.
sn45.174:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, catunnaṃ ganthānaṃ abhiññāya -pe- pariññāya -pe- parikkhayāya -pe- pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo. katamo ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti -pe- sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti. vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, catunnaṃ ganthānaṃ abhiññāya -pe- pariññāya -pe- parikkhayāya -pe- pahānāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabboti.
